Changelog

v1.1.0 (2026-06-15)
- Added exponential retry backoff in connection pool.
- Optimized LRU cache eviction speed by 40%.
- Fixed dead letter queue dropped task bug.

v1.0.0 (2026-01-10)
- Initial release of core microservices platform.
- Full JWT authentication integration.
- Prometheus metrics collector export endpoint.
